page.overview:
Who is Druksmald Goltanna?

Druksmald Goltanna, also styled as Druksmald Goltana,, is the duke of Zeltennia and a major secondary antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics, represented by the crest of the Black Lion. A member of the royal family of Ivalice through his relation to the late King Denamda II, Duke Goltanna commands the Order of the Southern Sky. He is one of two rival dukes vying for power in Ivalice, the other being Duke Larg, who leads the Order of the Northern Sky.

Following the death of King Ondoria III, who left no named heir, Goltanna sought to become guardian of the infant Prince Orinus and rule as regent. He was supported by the Council of nobles who opposed Duke Larg, who was in turn supported by Queen Louveria. Events led Goltanna to instead crown Ovelia Atkascha as queen, which Larg countered by declaring Prince Orinus the rightful heir, sparking the War of the Lions.

He uses the unique job of duke ("prince" in the PlayStation version).

Goltanna, like Larg, is descended from the line of King Denamda II, the monarch responsible for the Fifty Years' War. During this time he served as a general, leading the Order of the Southern Sky, and became the duke of Zeltennia at the end of the war. Until the end of the conflict and its subsequent period, Goltanna had Count Orlandeau in his service, who remained under his command for at least twenty years, leading them to develop a close friendship, although they disagreed on matters involving the wellbeing of the Ivalice commoners. In addition to Orlandeau, Goltanna had Chancellor Glevanne and Marquis Elmdore de Limberry as his close allies.
